project.title: Glitching Materiality - @THEVOID
project.description: Live performance using Hydra Video Synth.
project.introText: A live coding performance with Karolis Lasys at Expanded Publishing Fest 2: Space-in / Space-out, organised by the Institute of Network Cultures in Amsterdam in 2024.
project.middleText: The visuals were live-coded in Hydra Video Synth. The recording, about 18 minutes long, is published by the Institute of Network Cultures.
